Hex measurements, 2026-10-25 Asia/Tokyo
Apple M3; darwin/arm64; Go 1.27.0; TinyGo 0.42.0 / LLVM 22.1.4.
Five 300 ms samples per condition, GOMAXPROCS=1, sequential rotated binary order.
Each binary compares its own standard library with the selected backend.
go-asm is a default Go build using vector_arm64.s; go-archsimd is the previous
simd/archsimd backend at a1262d1, built with GOEXPERIMENT=simd.
Throughput counts raw bytes for both operations; destination buffers reused.
